description: This is a PHP source file defining the Error controller class in the Opencart Catalog Startup namespace. It handles error logging, error display, and exception handling for the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling PHP errors and exceptions within the startup phase of the Opencart Catalog framework.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes error handling by setting log, error, and exception handlers.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Handles PHP runtime errors, logs them if configured, displays them if configured, or redirects to an error page.

methods.name: exception
methods.description: Handles uncaught exceptions, logs them, displays error messages or redirects accordingly.
